title: Build transactional HTML email surviving Classic and New Outlook, Gmail 102 KB clipping, dark mode, and image blocking

contextSnapshot.surface: transactional order confirmation and receipt email
contextSnapshot.platform: HTML tables / MJML / React Email across Classic Outlook, New Outlook, Gmail, and Apple Mail

prompt: Create a transactional order confirmation email in React Email or MJML that survives both Classic Word-engine Outlook and New WebView2 Outlook, Gmail clipping, image blocking, and dark mode.
forbiddenBehaviors: puts the primary order message or CTA inside an image that vanishes when images are blocked
designs only around Classic Outlook VML while breaking New Outlook WebView2, or omits a real plaintext companion
claims cross-client compatibility from a single browser localhost preview

rubricDimensions.pass: addresses Classic vs New Outlook divergence, keeps HTML under 102 KB for Gmail, includes dark-mode meta/inversion guards, and uses role='presentation' + lang/dir
rubricDimensions.fail: depends on CSS Grid/variables or single-engine Outlook hacks that break other clients

rubricDimensions.pass: keeps essential details and CTA as live text with concise alt text and generates a structured plaintext variant
rubricDimensions.fail: treats plaintext as raw stripped HTML or hides essential info in graphics

negativeControls.name: browser preview pass
negativeControls.input: the React Email dev preview looks sharp in Chrome
negativeControls.mustNot: claim Outlook, Gmail dark mode, or image-blocked rendering are verified

baseline.withoutSkill: ships a flexbox/CSS-variable email with image-based banners, ignores New vs Classic Outlook and Gmail 102 KB limits, and skips plaintext parity
baseline.withSkill: builds table-safe MJML/React Email with Classic+New Outlook resilience, 102 KB clipping check, dark-mode/image-off survival, plaintext parity, and honest client labels
